faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Designs, free previews and credit costs explained.

items.question: What can I create with the AI tattoo generator?
items.answer: Describe a subject, style and composition to generate a tattoo design. For example, try a single black-ink olive branch with open space and no lettering. You can also upload an existing design or reuse a saved one, place it on your photo and request one realistic AI try-on. AI designs are references to review with an artist.

items.question: Can I use the tattoo generator for free?
items.answer: The saved interactive example and manual placement are free. New accounts receive 3 one-time welcome credits after email verification. A new design costs 1 credit; one AI try-on costs 1 / 2 / 3 credits at 1K / 2K / 4K. For example, one new design plus one 1K try-on uses 2 credits. Further AI generations require available credits.

items.question: Can I reuse earlier designs?
items.answer: Yes. Generated designs are saved automatically to My designs. Uploaded designs can be saved to your account. Selecting and placing saved designs is free; each new AI try-on is charged separately.

items.question: Can I leave while an image is generating?
items.answer: After submission is accepted, the task continues in the background. Return to the studio to follow your account task. Finished designs and try-ons are saved automatically. Unsubmitted placement edits are not saved.

items.question: What photo works best, and how accurate is the result?
items.answer: Use a clear, well-lit close-up or side-view photo with visible skin, and only photos of consenting adults. AI aims to preserve your photo but may alter details. Compare the result with your original.

items.question: What happens if generation fails?
items.answer: Confirmed generation failures return the credits used for that task. If the connection drops, resume the saved task rather than submitting again. Unconfirmed provider submissions hold the credit for support review.

items.question: Can I take the design to a tattoo artist?
items.answer: Download your design and try-on as references. Discuss the final artwork, size and tattoo feasibility with your artist.
